dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical and progressive 2D narrowing of the visible body mass starting from the mid-section and continuing toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are predominantly smooth with a subtle asymmetrical protrusion on the left mid-lateral edge.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity reflectance on the right dorsal surface transitioning into a shaded blue-grey gradient on the left lateral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, centrally located dark circular aperture (blowhole) visible on the anterior dorsal plane.
